scope: filter-hz 1.3.1: src/fx-hz.c's functions, which run only in the UI task to format the FX pages' text, are marked cold (built for size, out of the hot code); filter-hz.s is unchanged.
finding: Every function in fx-hz.c runs in the UI task when a value's text is drawn, never in the audio block, so it can be built for size. With every function left at -O2, the object compare before and after gives byte-identical instructions apart from relocation offsets; built cold, the module takes 200 bytes less of the RAM all modules share.
change: FHZ_UI = __attribute__((cold)) on mulhi, isqrt, atan2_q30, milli_hz, one_minus, fx_hz, clamp_word and the rest of fx-hz.c's functions. No behaviour change.

builds.label: CA01
builds.content: the same with the cold sources (this version's code; its comment text differs)

method: Modwerk's Rytm test rig in rytm-emu: CB00's screens recorded as references for the rig cases, then the same cases run on CA01 and compared with them.
results: CA01 passes all 26 emulator cases against CB00's references, with identical screens and measures: the seven Filter Hz cases (delay-turn, delay-lock, khz-pair, reverb-turn, reverb-scene, scene-edit, perf-edit) and the other modules' cases in the same image.
Independent code review of the change: no defect found.
limitations: The images held three other modules beside Filter Hz in a development base; Filter Hz alone on core-ar2 was used only for the documentation captures.
No audio was measured; the frequencies follow from the filter equations, as in 1.3.0.
